semantics: These are fail-closed evidence gates. READY means the rule is specified, not that parcel evidence passed.

gates.name: HMLR ZIP/GML official-byte chain
gates.rule: The download page must remain on the exact HMLR host/path. The ZIP final URL must be HTTPS and equal either the exact HMLR authority path or datapub-prd-s3-bucket.s3.amazonaws.com/inspire/London_Borough_of_Barking_and_Dagenham.zip. ZIP and extracted GML must be non-empty and independently SHA-256 hashed before parsing.

gates.name: HMLR native BNG polygon and receipt-bound INSPIRE identity
gates.rule: Require native EPSG:27700 valid positive-area Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry, plausible BNG bounds, an INSPIRE-semantic identifier column, one unique non-empty identifier per polygon, feature-count equality and identifier-set SHA-256. Measurement must use the exact receipt column and digest, must independently fail when the loaded GML is not EPSG:27700, and must never silently reproject an unverified GML.

gates.name: Point reprojection risk
gates.rule: HMLR guidance warns BNG-to-WGS84 conversion may shift features by up to 15m. Canonical matching stays in native EPSG:27700 and any non-native measurement GML fails closed.

gates.name: Unique strict-interior point-in-polygon
gates.rule: Spatial-index intersects is preliminary only. A canonical EPSG:27700 point must be strictly contained by exactly one verified INSPIRE polygon. Any geometry.touches(point) candidate rejects canonical binding.

gates.name: 15m fallback candidate handling
gates.rule: A 15m search may create candidates only; it cannot create a canonical polygon binding without unique strict-interior corroboration.

gates.name: GeoTIFF response signature
gates.rule: For probes and full-polygon rasters require classic TIFF II 42 or MM 42, successful rasterio opening and TIFF or octet-stream semantics. BigTIFF and malformed headers are rejected.

gates.name: Probe and full-raster CRS, grid and coverage
gates.rule: Every 10m probe must be single-band EPSG:27700 with approximately 1m cells, exact E and N subsets and raster bounds covering the requested BBOX. Full-polygon DTM must cover the complete bound polygon.

gates.name: Finite pixels and official NoData filtering
gates.rule: Exclude non-finite cells, raster metadata NoData and official EA sentinel -3.4028235e38. Zero remaining valid pixels fails closed.

gates.name: Terrain height-difference formula
gates.rule: Primary result is polygon DTM maximum minus polygon DTM minimum in metres AOD; p95-p05 is QA only.

gates.name: DTM requirement and DSM semantic isolation
gates.rule: DTM probe and full-polygon DTM are required. DSM is optional surface QA and cannot suppress a valid DTM terrain result.

gates.name: Survey-date metadata and CRS
gates.rule: Require official Composite metadata, explicit EPSG:27700 bbox/response CRS, one exact BNG geometry match, response and feature hashes, identifiers, resolution and date consistency.

gates.name: Final business-row evidence
gates.rule: Write a business row only after allowlisted HMLR ZIP host/path, ZIP/GML/identifier-set/polygon/DTM hashes, native EPSG:27700 measurement GML, receipt-bound INSPIRE identity, a polygon identifier not equal to empty/nan/none/null/<na>/nat, exactly one strict-interior polygon with zero boundary-touch candidates, content-verified DTM, valid full-polygon DTM pixels and strict survey provenance are all present.

gates.name: Runtime pending-state watchdog
gates.rule: The authoritative task must run through the slot outer watchdog. Forward child logs every five seconds, emit 60-second heartbeats, terminate the process tree after 1200 seconds without child stdout/stderr growth or 5400 total seconds, return 124 only for timeout, preserve FINAL_READY=false and clean temporary logs.

gates.name: Nested Python-stage realtime watchdog
gates.rule: The inner entry must form a four-stage SHA-256 chain and execute only the fourth carrier. Every carrier Python process must forward stdout/stderr every five seconds, emit 30-second heartbeats, stop at 1650 elapsed seconds with process-tree cleanup and return 124 for stage timeout.
